source_audit.source_name: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) Open Data
source_audit.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 with Historic England/Open Data Hub terms and OS attribution
source_audit.method: Queried Historic England ArcGIS FeatureServer listed-building point layer for London-area ListDate 2008-01-01 to 2026-05-19, removed ListEntry IDs already present in the manual corpus and round113/round114 London candidate files, and retained rows that are London architecture/heritage administrative designation events.
source_audit.caveats: ListDate is the date the asset was added to the statutory list, not a construction, opening, restoration, or real-world change date. Points are NHLE centroids, not building extents.

source_audit.source_name: Historic England Heritage at Risk Register 2025 and 2024 Open Data
source_audit.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 with Historic England/Open Data Hub terms and OS attribution
source_audit.method: Queried official HAR 2025 and HAR 2024 ArcGIS FeatureServers for the London area and selected 2025 rows whose List_Entry was absent from the 2024 snapshot, excluding the round114 Hill Garden Southern Pergola duplicate.
source_audit.caveats: This is a snapshot comparison against official annual geodata. It supports 'present in 2025 HAR and absent from 2024 HAR', not an exact survey date or cause of deterioration.

source_audit.source_name: Planning Data listed-building and listed-building-outline datasets
source_audit.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
source_audit.method: Checked Planning Data heritage dataset metadata and entity examples for stable entities, entry-date, start-date, points, and attribution.
source_audit.caveats: Planning Data listed-building rows largely republish NHLE records; listed-building-outline entry-date is a data update date and should not be treated as a heritage change event. No non-duplicate candidate was promoted from this family in this output.

source_audit.source_name: Planning applications: called-in decisions and recovered appeals
source_audit.method: Searched GOV.UK and Planning Inspectorate case pages for London heritage/listed-building called-in or recovered decision records not already in round114.
source_audit.caveats: Decision dates are administrative decision dates. Planning permission/listed-building consent is not evidence that works were completed.
